synopsis: IPG Automotive's commercial CarMaker, TruckMaker and off-highway stack target construction, agriculture and mining, providing closed-loop vehicle, driver, environment and sensor simulation across MIL, SIL, HIL and vehicle-in-the-loop testing [f8436, f8437, f9239]. Named vendor examples include lidar accident prevention with Linde and vehicle-in-the-loop testing with real tractors; expert opinion identifies rigid-vehicle and system dynamics as strengths, rather than high-fidelity deformable soil and particle interaction [f8438, f8439, f8443]. Cross-chapter precedents include PEGASUS using IPG simulation and a 19 May 2021 publication reporting a typical minimum simulated range of about 20–30 m for digital radar simulators; a 2024 CarMaker ultrasonic-model validation is labeled Independent on-road evidence in one passage but explicitly described as not vendor-independent because of author affiliations in another [f1578, f5306, f4575, f4576]. Independent heavy-machine automatic-braking validation, independent severe-dust/snow/glare evidence, and a same-machine public stopping-distance benchmark were not found, leaving important application-specific validation gaps [f8289, f8444, f6561]. CarMaker reached version 15.0 in 2025, but public prices and a TruckMaker-specific latest release date were not found; IPG also offers consulting and appears in the highest-cost example integration-and-correlation chain [f8441, f8442, f8806, f9308].
